verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated SOC 2 product with automated tests, continuous monitoring, and AI evidence review. It also offers a library of controls you can add, AI-drafted policies, auditor collaboration, and information request lists for audits, which covers the core of running a SOC 2 program in-platform. missing for 10: explicit evidence of Type I vs Type II audit support, explicit mapping to the Trust Services Criteria, pre-built SOC 2 policy templates (only AI policy drafting is cited), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
